page.layout: One printed page, one text block in full width with a bracketed note at right beside the two names Lauffero and Chambrino. Top: an ornamental rule. Below: the dedication lines, then the body in order from top to bottom. No running head, no page number, no catchword.

main_text.l: Magnificentissimo, Amplissimo, Authoritate ac Potestate
Conspicuo Viro,
Dn. ABRAHAMO à WERTH, Reipublicæ Bernensis
Quæstori, quoad ditionem germanicam haud ita pridem cum
laude defuncto, Fautori ac Patrono suo summo obsequiô co-
lendo, amando.
Venerando Cœtui Ecclesiastico, Vigilantissimis Dn. Ministris &
Administris, Profesoribus acutissimis ac sagacissimis, Dn.
suis Mecœnatibus, Fautoribus ac Promotoribus omni obser-
vantiæ genere honorandis, & ex iis
Dn. ABRAHAMO de LOSEA, verbi Dei Ministro ac Pa-
stori vigilantissimo, Affini suo plurimùm honorando.
Dn. DAVIDI ALBINO, Philosophiæ Professori acutissimo,
Collegij minoris inspectori fidelissimo, Fautori, Studiorum
suorum promotori æternùm colendo.
Dn. SAMUELI HENTZIO, in florentissimo Bernatum Ly-
cæo Linguæ Græcæ & Philosophiæ Practicæ Professori or-
dinario, fratri germano dilectissimo & plurimùm fraterno
amore prosequendo.
Ut Et
Dn. JOH. ANTHONIO KILCHBERGERO, Præfe-
cturâ in Arwangen laudabiliter defuncto, Benefactori suo aman-
tissimo honoris & amoris genere prosequendo.
Quin Etiam
Dn. CASPARO LAUFFERO, Dn.
CHRISTIANO CHAMBRINO,
Nec Non
WOLFFGANGO MESSMERO, Ludimagistro lu-
di literarij ibidem fidissimo, Præceptori suo olim amore jugi-
ter devenerando.
Dn. ADAMO SALCHLINO, Hypodidascalo Scholæ Ca-
strovillanæ indefesso, Affini suo multùm honorando.
CORNELIUS HENTZIUS, Resp.

marginalia.note: Ecclesiæ Zoffinganæ Pastoribus Vigilantissimis, Fautoribus suis colendis.

page.notes: The bracket at right beside the two names Lauffero and Chambrino is a grouping brace for the note, transcribed as a right-side note. Some letters in the dedications are blurred by the scan; the names Kilchbergero and Arwangen were read with some doubt. The initial "Dn." abbreviations are printed in small capitals.
